name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana (MMVY)
department: Technical Education, Skill Development and Employment Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

benefit.description: Admission fee and the actual tuition fee fixed by the fee regulatory committee / MP private university regulatory commission / Government (mess fee and caution money excluded), every year until the course ends. Private engineering colleges: up to INR 1.5 lakh or the actual fee, whichever is less. The amount depends on the course and institution.

conditions.description: Student is a resident of Madhya Pradesh
conditions.failure_message: MMVY is only for residents of Madhya Pradesh.

conditions.description: Father's / guardian's annual income is less than INR 8,00,000
conditions.source_ref: Consolidated order 09/07/2026 para 2.2 (ceiling raised from INR 6 lakh by order dated 18-08-2023)

conditions.description: Class 12 merit - MP Board 70% or more, or CBSE/ICSE 85% or more

items.description: MP Board (MPBSE) class 12 with at least 70%
CBSE or ICSE class 12 with at least 85%
Class 12 passed from CBSE or ICSE

conditions.failure_message: Students of other boards or below these percentages are not covered.

conditions.description: Admitted to a graduate-level course covered by the scheme
conditions.source_ref: Consolidated order 09/07/2026 para 3 ("snatak star ki shiksha")

relationships.reason: Para 4.3 of the consolidated order: a student who receives assistance from another State or Central scheme can receive the difference amount under MMVY.

limitations: Course and institution coverage (para 3) is not modelled: private colleges are covered only for BE/BTech (JEE Main rank within 1,50,000) and MBBS (NEET rank within 1.5 lakh); other courses must be at Government of India, State Government or aided institutions or be polytechnic diplomas.
JEE / NEET / CLAT ranks, the one-course-only rule (para 4.1) and timely course completion are not checked.
Students of state boards other than MPBSE and of boards other than CBSE/ICSE are not covered (they FAIL the class 12 merit condition; profiles with board 'other' therefore fail it).

The discretionary special case in para 2.2 (SC/ST or BPL students up to INR 8 lakh who miss the course conditions, with competent-authority approval) and continuation of the benefit after income rises above INR 8 lakh are not modelled.
The FAQ (Q4) implies a 75% MP Board threshold for students who passed before 2018; the order only states 70% from session 2018-19. Pre-2018 pass-outs are evaluated with 70% - confirm with the portal.
Aadhaar-linked bank account and fee receipts are required for payment but are not checked here.
application_steps: Register on the MMVY portal https://www.medhavikalyan.mp.gov.in and note the user ID and password (FAQ Q22).
Submit the online application with the domicile certificate, class 10 and 12 mark sheets, entrance-exam scorecard (if applicable), income certificate, Samagra ID and item-wise fee receipt (FAQ Q23).
Submit the application print-out and documents to your institution, which verifies and recommends it.
The sanctioning authority sanctions the benefit and the disbursing authority pays the fee (SOP v1.3).
Apply again every year of the course; arrears for years not applied for are not paid (FAQ Q31-Q32).
